title: Book Three · Chapter 146: The Question He Asks
story:
On Tuesday after school, Ronan goes to the workshop.

He brings his notebook, not his work cloth. He needs to talk about the last Saturday.

Mr Sun is at the front with a customer. Ronan waits near the door until they finish.

Then he shows Mr Sun the visitor date.

“Anna can see a design school that morning. I want to go with her. Could we change my last work day?”

Mr Sun opens the book with the three dates.

“Not to another morning. That is when the other helper is away.”

Ronan looks at the final line.

“What if I can't come?”

“Tell me by Friday. I will need to change two collection times.”

“Could Dad do the front part?” Ronan asks.

Mr Sun looks toward the work benches.

“He has work for that morning too.”

Ronan follows his eyes. A large piece is waiting beside the back wall. It will not move to the front by itself.

He looks at the two customer names again.

“Do they both come in the morning?”

“Yes. One has a journey before he gets here.”

Ronan wants to ask for a different answer. He has already asked about another work day, and now about another person.

Mr Sun leaves the book open.

“You can still tell me you can't come. I need to know in time to speak to them.”

Ronan reads the names once more. Neither customer knows about Anna's visit. They only know the time Mr Sun gave them.

He moves his own notebook nearer the edge. The visitor date is clear on its page. He runs a finger along the edge of the page, then puts the book beside Mr Sun's.

He shows Ronan the customer notes beside that morning. One person is coming from outside town. Mr Sun has arranged to check a large piece at the back while Ronan handles the front.

“Think about it,” he says. “Then give me a clear answer.”

Ronan nods. He still has a choice. It will change other people's plans too.

Dad comes to wash his hands. He sees the open notebook.

“A date problem?”

Ronan tells him about the visit.

“You want to see the school?”

“I want to go with Anna.”

Dad waits. Ronan looks toward the measuring table.

“And I want to do this work. I said I would be here.”

“Both are true,” Dad says.

He dries his hands and goes back to his own job. Ronan closes the notebook and puts it in his bag.

Outside, a customer is trying to open the gate with a parcel under one arm. Ronan holds the gate for her. She thanks him and carries the parcel inside.

He watches her reach the counter. There is another question on her face before she puts the parcel down.

On the road home, Ronan takes the visitor sheet copy out once more. Eleven until three. Another city. The work morning ends at twelve here.

He folds the two different pieces of paper together.

Mum is reading when he comes home. She puts a finger between the pages and looks up.

“You asked?”

“Yes. I need to answer by Friday.”

She nods and waits while he puts his bag away. Then Ronan sits near her chair and starts to tell her the two choices aloud.

Mum asks what Anna has heard so far.

“I told her I would ask,” he says. “She knows about the work date.”

His mother nods and lets him finish.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

collection＝取货；handle＝处理、接待；parcel＝包裹；aloud＝出声地。

## 理解问题

1. Mr Sun是否把Ronan完全锁死在工作上？取消会影响哪两类实际安排？
2. Ronan承认了哪两个同时存在的愿望？他这天已经去上班领钱了吗？

## 读句子

**Ronan closes the notebook and puts it in his bag.**

拆开看：Ronan / closes the notebook / and puts it / in his bag.

Ronan／合上本子／然后把它放进／自己的包里。
